correctness.rationale: For a uniform random permutation, independent continuous ranks represent comparisons. Each maximal selected descent run uses a disjoint block of independent variables, so its signed moment is Eulerian A_(ell+1)(-1)/(ell+1)!. The exponential Eulerian identity at -1 equals 1+tanh z, making odd run lengths zero and even run lengths signed nonzero tangent numbers. Binary masks with exclusively even-length one-runs follow a Fibonacci recurrence. Walsh characters diagonalize convolution. Direct exact enumeration independently checked all 510 multipliers for n=2 through 9. This is a proof for every integer n at least two, not an extrapolation from those finite checks.

value.rationale: The complete first-principles Fourier spectrum of the natural full positional descent distribution has a sharp nontrivial kernel: exactly F_n recoverable modes among 2^(n-1). This exponential concentration of observable modes and explicit nonzero multipliers answer an all-orders inverse/recoverability question, beyond a low-degree covariance or textbook single Eulerian coefficient. The result remains specific to ordinary adjacent descents.
